items.name: Fiserv
items.headline: Reports Q3 results with a $6,452 million goodwill impairment
items.catalyst: Q3 GAAP revenue of $5,196 million versus $5,263 million; diluted EPS of $(11.17) versus $1.46; adjusted EPS $1.75.
items.thesis: The company affirmed 2026 organic revenue of (1%) to 0% and adjusted EPS of $7.20 to $7.40. The GAAP loss reflects the non-cash impairment.

items.name: ADT
items.headline: Withdraws guidance after agreeing to be acquired by Thrive Holdings
items.catalyst: Agreed Oct. 29 to be acquired for $10.00 per share in cash; Q3 revenue $1,349 million versus $1,298 million.
items.thesis: Closing is expected in Q1 2027, subject to stockholder and U.S. antitrust approval. The company is not providing financial guidance.

items.name: IPG Photonics
items.headline: Reports Q3 revenue growth and issues Q4 guidance
items.catalyst: Q3 revenue of $287.5 million versus $250.8 million; adjusted EPS $0.61 versus $0.35.
items.thesis: Q4 guidance is revenue of $265 million to $295 million and adjusted EPS of $0.30 to $0.60, excluding the Lumibird Medical acquisition.

items.name: BioNTech
items.headline: Reports Q3 results and updates full-year revenue range
items.catalyst: Q3 revenue of €1,289.2 million versus €1,518.9 million; IFRS diluted EPS €0.73 versus €(0.12).
items.thesis: Full-year 2026 revenue guidance is now €1,700 million to €1,900 million versus €1,600 million to €1,900 million previously.

items.name: Apollo Global Management
items.headline: Reports Q3 results and declares quarterly dividend
items.catalyst: Dividend of $0.5625 per share; origination of $114 billion in the quarter; about $1.07 trillion of AUM.
items.thesis: The dividend is payable Nov. 30 to holders of record at the close of business Nov. 18.

items.name: ExxonMobil
items.headline: Reports Q3 earnings of $15.4B and announces $20B of 2027 share repurchases
items.catalyst: Q3 earnings were $15.4 billion, or $3.72 per share; the board declared a $1.07 fourth-quarter dividend.
items.thesis: Cash flow from operating activities was $25.7 billion and free cash flow was $19.1 billion. The buyback figure assumes reasonable market conditions.
